limitations: Selected candidate statements plus every FAQ answer; not every sentence of the body.
Competitor comparisons and the 6 MB timing are dated observations from 2026-10-02 and were not re-run.
Test Suite counts are tied to the bundled fixture commit 5b0ee1613e45fcc2bddac00e07c19cd49b00d8a8; the page text is not dated.
Python jsonschema 4.26.0 was checked against its documentation; the installed comparison run used 4.23.0.
Primary sources were retrieved on 2026-10-27; undated help pages can change.

statements.statement: Check JSON, YAML or JSON Lines against a JSON Schema from draft-04 to 2020-12. Errors link to the data line and schema keyword. Runs in your browser, no upload.
statements.qualification: JSON and JSON Lines errors carry a line and a schema range; YAML validation errors carry the path only (limits). “No upload” is true for schema and data, not page assets.

statements.statement: Choose a draft or keep Auto, and select whether to Check format. Only these two settings are saved.
statements.qualification: Component saves {draft, formats} through ztPersist; policy is preference.

statements.statement: Open Referenced schemas for external $ref targets. Give each schema its $id and separate schemas with a line containing only ---. Nothing is downloaded.
statements.qualification: parseExtras requires an $id for each document and splits on a line containing only ---; no fetch exists in the engine.

statements.statement: Draft-04, draft-06, draft-07, 2019-09 and 2020-12. The tool reads the draft from $schema. A schema without $schema is checked as 2020-12, the same default as Python jsonschema and Go santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema.
statements.qualification: All five drafts are implemented. Both libraries document “latest implemented draft”, which is 2020-12 today; neither promises a fixed default version.

statements.statement: When $schema names draft-04, or you pick Draft 4 in the menu, an old draft-04 schema works as it is: boolean exclusiveMinimum / exclusiveMaximum and id keep their draft-04 meaning.
statements.qualification: Draft 4 uses AjvDraft04, id as the identifier keyword, and boolean exclusive bounds.

statements.statement: Without either, it is checked as 2020-12, where a boolean exclusiveMaximum makes the schema itself not valid.
statements.qualification: 2020-12 meta-schema requires a number for exclusiveMaximum; the ja example shows the meta-schema error.

statements.statement: Ajv checks the schema and data in your browser tab without uploading them for validation. The tool does not fetch URLs referenced by $ref; paste those schemas under Referenced schemas.
statements.qualification: Validation runs in a Web Worker (main-thread fallback only if the Worker cannot start); the engine has no fetch.

statements.statement: Only the draft menu and Check format setting are saved in this browser’s localStorage, not the schema, referenced schemas or data. Ctrl/⌘+L clears current inputs while keeping settings; clearing this site’s browser data removes the settings.
statements.qualification: savePrefs writes exactly {draft, formats}; the global Ctrl+L clears textareas/text inputs and ztPersist.clear returns early for preference.

statements.statement: The page loads Google Analytics and AdSense. After a committed input/settings change, file load, example or Validate action completes, usage events contain the tool name and result kind (valid, invalid, undetermined, or a schema/input problem).
statements.qualification: The page is not in disabledPersistenceSlugs, so ToolLayout renders the AdUnits and BaseLayout loads gtag/adsbygoogle when the env IDs are set. run(true) is the only path that calls trackTool, with slug and action only.

statements.statement: Repeating the same result is deduplicated per action. Typing, boot previews, cancelled or obsolete work and Worker failures do not emit usage events. Events contain no schema or data; copying a report writes it to your clipboard without a separate copy event.
statements.qualification: trackedResults compares JSON.stringify(res) per action; run(false), abandoned runs, load errors and copy() do not call trackTool.

statements.statement: Word replaces straight quotation marks with curly ones (smart quotes) as you type, so the pasted keys and strings start with “ instead of ". JSON accepts only the straight double quote, so the tool stops at the first curly quote and reports its line and column.
statements.qualification: Word’s AutoFormat As You Type behavior and the Windows Options path were not rechecked today; the JSON rule and the tool’s smart-quote diagnostic are implemented.

statements.statement: Yes, while Check format is on (the default): email, uri, uri-reference, uri-template, date, time, date-time, duration, hostname, ipv4, ipv6, uuid, json-pointer, relative-json-pointer and regex, through ajv-formats.
statements.qualification: ASSERTED_FORMATS has these 15 names and addFormats registers them; the switch is checked in the markup.

statements.statement: Turn the switch off to treat format as an annotation, which is the default of the 2020-12 specification and of Python jsonschema.
statements.qualification: 2020-12 §7.2.1 requires assertion evaluation to be disabled by default; Python jsonschema says no format validation is done without a format_checker.

statements.statement: Other formats, such as idn-email or iri, pass and are listed in a note.
statements.qualification: Unknown formats are retried as always-true and added to the formatUnchecked notice; no validation is performed for them.

statements.statement: Usually the draft, format checking or a keyword the draft does not have. The notes under the result list what this tool ignored: unknown keywords, keywords next to $ref in draft 4–7, nullable from OpenAPI 3.0, and formats it does not check.
statements.qualification: prepareSchema removes post-draft keywords, $ref siblings in drafts 4–7, nullable and id, and reports each; unsupported formats are added as always-true and listed.

statements.statement: pattern also differs between implementations: it follows ECMA-262, where \d matches only the ASCII digits 0–9, while Python\'s re also matches full-width digits.
statements.qualification: Ajv compiles the pattern with new RegExp(value, "u"); ECMA-262 \d is [0-9]; Python re uses Unicode decimal digits.

statements.statement: When the schema compares a number such as 9007199254740993 that JavaScript cannot hold exactly, or reaches a case Ajv is known to get wrong, this tool says "Cannot be determined" instead of giving a result.
statements.qualification: The engine marks the document unknown for lossy numbers when the schema has a numeric keyword, and for the structural Ajv limitations in unsupportedOf.

statements.statement: Yes. Any JSON value can be the root, including an array. For many records, paste JSON Lines (one JSON value per line) or YAML documents separated by ---; each document is validated on its own, and the result lists the documents that have errors or cannot be determined.
statements.qualification: JSON and YAML multi-document input work as described. JSON Lines is detected only when the first non-blank line starts with { or [; scalar-first streams fall through to YAML and are rejected. The page does not state that condition.

statements.statement: The product example reports 4 errors at 4 locations, each with a line and a schema path: price, tags, dimensions and warehouseLocation/latitude.
statements.qualification: Output is regenerated by the jsv-ex annotations in scripts/test-json-schema-validator.mjs against the same engine.

statements.statement: Python jsonschema 4.26.0 gives the same answer: code passes (the maxLength is ignored) and nickname: null fails. Plain Ajv reports the opposite on both fields.
statements.qualification: Draft-07 §8.3 requires siblings of $ref to be ignored; jsonschema 4.23.0 (installed) behaves the same, and plain Ajv 8.18 applies maxLength and accepts null.

statements.statement: "$dynamicRef" at #/properties/children/items/$dynamicRef: Ajv implements dynamic references only in part and gives wrong results on some official test cases.
statements.qualification: Plain Ajv 8.18 on the 2020-12 dynamicRef.json groups (44 cases) gave 12 wrong verdicts and 21 schema errors in a direct run; the test also records at least 25 known failures.

statements.statement: The other cases are $recursiveRef whose first target has no "$recursiveAnchor": true, nested $id with relative $ref, unevaluatedItems / unevaluatedProperties together with contains, an if without both then and else, or items inside an anyOf / oneOf branch.
statements.qualification: Engine conditions are narrower: $recursiveRef is flagged only when another resource has the anchor; contains and branch items are paired with unevaluatedItems only; the partial-if case requires unevaluatedItems or unevaluatedProperties. Text corrected in en, zh and ja.

statements.statement: We ran six inputs through the first results for "json schema validator" on Bing on 2026-10-02: a draft-07 $ref with maxLength next to it, "required": ["constructor"] against {}, nullable with null, 9007199254740993 against maximum 9007199254740992, a 2020-12 prefixItems schema, and YAML data.
statements.qualification: Dated competitor observation; this run did not repeat the searches or the requests. Kept as a historical record, not a current guarantee.

statements.statement: | Validator | Upload | $ref sibling | constructor | nullable | 2^53 | 2020-12 | YAML |
statements.qualification: Table rows are the 2026-10-02 observations; not re-executed. The ZeroTool column matches current code and the local test corpus.

statements.statement: The correct answers are: ignored, fails, fails, fails. No browser-side validator can get the 2^53 case right, because JSON.parse turns both numbers into 9007199254740992 before validation.
statements.qualification: The universal claim was too strong: a validator can read the number source. Changed to “A validator that compares only the numbers JSON.parse returns cannot get the 2^53 case right”. zh got the same qualification.

statements.statement: The validator is Ajv 8.18 with ajv-formats 3.0.1 and ajv-draft-04 1.0.0. On the required tests of the official JSON Schema Test Suite, 616 of 618 draft-04, 839 of 841 draft-06, 927 of 929 draft-07, 1,230 of 1,261 for 2019-09 and 1,210 of 1,301 for 2020-12 match; no test is wrong.
statements.qualification: Versions match package.json. Counts match today’s run against the bundled fixture (suite commit 5b0ee1613e45fcc2bddac00e07c19cd49b00d8a8); the page does not date or pin the suite, so the numbers are not a claim about every suite revision.

statements.statement: $ref to a URL is never fetched. Paste the referenced schema, with its $id, under Referenced schemas.
statements.qualification: No fetch in the engine; buildValidator reports missingRef and the UI points to the Referenced schemas field.

statements.statement: When the schema compares numbers (type, minimum, maximum, multipleOf, const, enum, uniqueItems), that document is Cannot be determined. Duplicate keys keep the last value and get a note.
statements.qualification: The numeric keyword list omitted exclusiveMinimum / exclusiveMaximum, which the engine also counts. YAML duplicate keys are a parse error (js-yaml), so the duplicate-key note is now scoped to JSON.

statements.statement: Line numbers are shown for JSON and JSON Lines. YAML errors show the path only.
statements.qualification: YAML syntax errors do carry a line and column (parseErrorText; test asserts line 2). Only YAML data validation errors lack a line. Text now says “Validation errors in YAML data”.

statements.statement: Inputs over 1 MB are checked when you press Validate; files over 20 MB are refused.
statements.qualification: AUTO_LIMIT is 1,000,000 UTF-16 code units, not 1 MB; FILE_LIMIT is 20 * 1024 * 1024 bytes (20 MiB). Text and the fileTooBig string now use those units.

statements.statement: A 6 MB array of 40,000 records took about 2 seconds in our test, with no main-thread task of 50 ms or more while it ran.
statements.qualification: Historical local timing, not re-run in this pass. Kept as a dated-by-context observation; the page says “in our test”.

statements.statement: pattern is an ECMA-262 regular expression with the u flag. \d matches only ASCII digits, so Python re (where \d also matches １２３) can disagree.
statements.qualification: Ajv docs state new RegExp(value, "u"); ECMA-262 \d is [0-9]; Python re is Unicode-aware.

statements.statement: 按 JSON Schema（draft-04 至 2020-12）校验 JSON、YAML 或 JSON Lines，错误定位到数据行和 Schema 关键字，并提示大整数、重复键和全角标点。在浏览器内运行，不上传。
statements.qualification: JSON 与 JSON Lines 有行列与 Schema 位置；YAML 数据的校验错误只有路径（限制段已写明）。“不上传”指 Schema 与数据，页面仍加载统计与广告。

statements.statement: 选择草案版本或保留自动模式，并设置是否“检查 format”。浏览器只保存这两项设置。
statements.qualification: savePrefs 只写 draft 与 formats；policy 为 preference。

statements.statement: draft-04、draft-06、draft-07、2019-09 和 2020-12。工具按 $schema 判断版本；没有 $schema 时按 2020-12 校验，与 Python jsonschema、Go santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema 的默认一致。
statements.qualification: 五个草案都已实现；两个库的文档说的是“已实现的最新草案”，今天是 2020-12，不是固定版本承诺。

statements.statement: Ajv 在浏览器标签页中校验 Schema 和数据，不会为校验而上传它们。工具不会请求 $ref 引用的网址；请把引用的 Schema 粘贴到“被引用的 Schema”中。
statements.qualification: Worker 内校验（Worker 无法启动时才回退主线程），引擎没有 fetch。

statements.statement: 本浏览器的 localStorage 只保存草案菜单和“检查 format”设置，不保存 Schema、引用的 Schema 或数据。Ctrl/⌘+L 清空当前输入并保留设置。
statements.qualification: savePrefs 只写两项；全局 Ctrl+L 清空文本输入，ztPersist.clear 对 preference 提前返回。

statements.statement: 本页加载 Google Analytics 和 AdSense。输入或设置更改确认、文件载入、示例或“校验”操作完成后，使用事件记录工具名和结果类型；事件不含 Schema 或数据。
statements.qualification: 页面不在 disabledPersistenceSlugs 中；仅 run(true) 调用 trackTool，参数只有 slug 与 action；copy 不发事件。

statements.statement: 浏览器用 JSON.parse 读数字，超过 2^53（9007199254740992）的整数会丢失精度，例如 1842390023517843457 会变成 1842390023517843500。Schema 要比较这类数字时，工具显示“无法确定”。
statements.qualification: JSON.parse 的双精度转换与示例数值一致；引擎在 Schema 有数值关键字时置 unknown。

statements.statement: Python jsonschema 用任意精度整数，会按原值判断；浏览器里的校验器都做不到。
statements.qualification: “浏览器里的校验器都做不到”是绝对说法：能读源码数字的校验器可以做到。改为“只按 JSON.parse 读出的数字判定的浏览器校验器做不到”。

statements.statement: YAML 的错误只显示路径，不显示行号。
statements.qualification: YAML 语法错误带行列（parseErrorText，测试断言第 2 行）；只有 YAML 数据的校验错误没有行号。改为“YAML 数据的校验错误”。

statements.statement: 2026-10-02 用同一组输入测试了 cn.bing.com 搜索“json schema 校验”排名第一的在线工具大全（lddgo.net），默认规范为 Draft-07。
statements.qualification: 带日期的竞品观察，本次未重跑搜索或请求；保留为历史记录。

statements.statement: Ajv 已知会判错的情况都按“无法确定”处理：$dynamicRef、首个目标没有 $recursiveAnchor 的 $recursiveRef、相对引用加嵌套 $id、unevaluatedItems / unevaluatedProperties 与 contains、缺 then 或 else 的 if、anyOf / oneOf 分支内的 items 组合。
statements.qualification: 引擎只在另一个资源有 $recursiveAnchor 时才标记该 $recursiveRef；contains 与分支 items 只和 unevaluatedItems 组合；缺 then/else 的 if 需要与 unevaluatedItems 或 unevaluatedProperties 同用。文字已按条件改写。

statements.statement: Schema 要比较数字时，该文档显示“无法确定”……重复的键只保留最后一个值，也会提示。
statements.qualification: YAML 的重复键是解析错误（js-yaml），不会“保留最后一个值”。已限定为 JSON。

statements.statement: 超过 1 MB 的输入需要点“验证”；超过 20 MB 的文件不读取。
statements.qualification: 阈值是三个输入合计 1,000,000 个 UTF-16 编码单元；文件上限是 20 * 1024 * 1024 字节（20 MiB）。已按界面步骤改写。

statements.statement: pattern 按 ECMA-262 正则（u 标志）执行，\d 只匹配半角数字 0–9。
statements.qualification: Ajv 用 new RegExp(value, "u")；ECMA-262 \d 为 [0-9]。

statements.statement: ドラフトを選ぶか自動のままにして、「format を検証」を設定します。保存されるのはこの 2 つの設定だけです。
statements.qualification: savePrefs は draft と formats だけを保存する。

statements.statement: draft-04、draft-06、draft-07、2019-09、2020-12 です。$schema からドラフトを判定し、$schema がなければ 2020-12 として検証します（Python jsonschema や Go の santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema と同じ既定値）。
statements.qualification: 5 ドラフトを実装済み。両ライブラリの文書は「実装済みの最新ドラフト」であり、2026-10-27 時点で 2020-12。固定バージョンの約束ではない。

statements.statement: Ajv はブラウザのタブでスキーマとデータを検証し、検証のためにアップロードしません。$ref の参照先 URL は取得しないので、参照先のスキーマを専用欄に貼り付けてください。
statements.qualification: Worker 内で検証（Worker が作れないときだけメインスレッド）。エンジンに fetch はない。

statements.statement: このブラウザの localStorage に保存するのはドラフトと「format を検証」の設定だけで、スキーマ、参照先のスキーマ、データは保存しません。Ctrl/⌘+L は現在の入力を消して設定を残します。
statements.qualification: savePrefs は 2 項目だけ。グローバル Ctrl+L はテキスト入力だけを消し、preference の clear は何もしない。

statements.statement: ページは Google Analytics と AdSense を読み込みます。入力・設定の変更の確定、ファイルの読み込み、例の選択、検証ボタンによる処理が完了すると、利用イベントにツール名と結果の種類を記録します。
statements.qualification: disabledPersistenceSlugs に含まれないため広告枠とタグが有効。trackTool は run(true) のみ、引数は slug と action。

statements.statement: JSON Schema の pattern は ECMA-262（JavaScript）の正規表現で、\d は半角の 0〜9 だけに一致します。全角の「１２３」は一致しません。Python の jsonschema は Python の re を使うため \d が全角数字にも一致し、同じデータが通ることがあります。
statements.qualification: Ajv は new RegExp(value, "u")、ECMA-262 の \d は [0-9]、Python re は Unicode の Nd。

statements.statement: 「format を検証」がオン（既定）のとき、ajv-formats が実装する email、uri、date、date-time、time、duration、hostname、ipv4、ipv6、uuid など 15 種類を検証します。
statements.qualification: ASSERTED_FORMATS の 15 名を addFormats に渡し、チェックボックスは checked。

statements.statement: オフにすると format は注釈になり、2020-12 仕様や Python jsonschema の既定と同じ動作になります。
statements.qualification: 2020-12 §7.2.1 はアサーションを既定で無効にすることを要求。Python も format_checker なしでは検証しない。

statements.statement: よくある原因は、ドラフトの違い、draft 4〜7 で $ref と並べたキーワード（仕様上は無視）、OpenAPI 3.0 の nullable、つづりの誤りなどでそのドラフトにないキーワード、format を検証するかどうか、pattern の \d、2^53 を超える整数です。
statements.qualification: prepareSchema が後発キーワード、$ref の並置キーワード、nullable を除去して通知する。

statements.statement: データのルートは配列を含め、どの JSON 値でもかまいません。複数のレコードは JSON Lines（1 行に 1 つの JSON 値）か、--- で区切った複数の YAML ドキュメントとして貼り付けてください。
statements.qualification: JSON と複数 YAML は記載どおり。JSON Lines は最初の非空行が { か [ のときだけ認識され、スカラー先頭のストリームは YAML として失敗する。ページはこの条件を書いていない。

statements.statement: 古いツールが生成したスキーマには draft-04 のものが残っています。draft-04 の exclusiveMaximum は真偽値で、maximum の値を含まないことを表します。
statements.qualification: draft-04 validation §5.1.2.1 のとおり。例の出力はテストで再計算される。

statements.statement: The draft-04 example reports score 100 against maximum 100 with exclusiveMaximum true, ignores const as an unknown keyword, and after switching the menu to 2020-12 reports the boolean exclusiveMaximum as a schema error.
statements.qualification: Both outputs are regenerated by the jsv-ex annotations in the test; draft-04 validation §5.1.2.1 defines the boolean form.

statements.statement: const は draft-06 で追加されたキーワードなので、draft-04 では無視されます（Python jsonschema の Draft4Validator も同じ判定です）。
statements.qualification: draft-04 に const はなく、未知キーワードは無視される。エンジンは draft-04 で const を除去して通知する。

statements.statement: JavaScript の数値（倍精度浮動小数点数）では 20261002123456789012 を正確に表せず、20261002123456790000 として読まれます。伝票番号は文字列で送り、type: string と pattern で桁数を検査するのが確実です。
statements.qualification: Number の丸め結果は Node で一致。エンジンは Schema が数値を比較するとき unknown にする。

statements.statement: 数値のほかに、$dynamicRef、unevaluatedItems / unevaluatedProperties と contains・then か else のない if・anyOf / oneOf 内の items の組み合わせ、相対参照と入れ子の $id、$vocabulary を変えたメタスキーマ、データにもある __proto__ プロパティも同じ扱いです。
statements.qualification: エンジンは contains と分岐内 items を unevaluatedItems との組み合わせでのみ扱い、if は unevaluatedItems / unevaluatedProperties と併用したときだけ扱う。3 つの組み合わせに分けて書き直した。

statements.statement: 2026-10-02 に、Bing（日本）で「JSON Schema 検証」の 1 位だった ToolkitsLab の JSON Schema 検証ツールで同じ入力を試しました。
statements.qualification: 日付付きの競合観察。本次は検索もリクエストも再実行していない。歴史的記録として保持。

statements.statement: 公式の JSON Schema Test Suite（必須テスト）では、draft-04 が 618 件中 616 件、draft-07 が 929 件中 927 件、2020-12 が 1,301 件中 1,210 件で期待どおりの結果になり、残りは「判定できません」になります。
statements.qualification: 件数は同梱 fixture（suite commit 5b0ee1613e45fcc2bddac00e07c19cd49b00d8a8）の本日実行と一致。ページは suite の版を固定していないため、全改訂への主張ではない。

statements.statement: multipleOf は 10 進数の値で判定するため、19.99 は 0.01 の倍数、0.3 は 0.1 の倍数になります。重複したキーは最後の値だけが残り、注意を表示します。
statements.qualification: YAML の重複キーは js-yaml の解析エラーで、最後の値は残らない。JSON に限定した。

statements.statement: YAML のエラーはパスだけを表示し、行番号は出ません。
statements.qualification: YAML の構文エラーは行・列を持つ（テストが 2 行目を確認）。行番号がないのは YAML データの検証エラー。文言を限定した。

statements.statement: 1 MB を超える入力は「検証」ボタンで実行し、20 MB を超えるファイルは読み込みません。
statements.qualification: AUTO_LIMIT は 3 入力合計 1,000,000 UTF-16 コード単位、FILE_LIMIT は 20 * 1024 * 1024 バイト（20 MiB）。文言と fileTooBig を合わせた。

statements.statement: 드래프트를 고르거나 자동으로 두고 “format 검사”를 설정하세요. 이 두 설정만 저장합니다.
statements.qualification: savePrefs는 draft와 formats만 저장한다.

statements.statement: draft-04, draft-06, draft-07, 2019-09, 2020-12입니다. $schema로 드래프트를 판단하고, $schema가 없으면 2020-12로 검증합니다(Python jsonschema, Go santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema와 같은 기본값).
statements.qualification: 5개 드래프트 구현. 두 라이브러리 문서는 “구현된 최신 드래프트”를 뜻하며 2026-10-27 현재 2020-12다. 고정 버전 약속은 아니다.

statements.statement: Ajv는 브라우저 탭에서 스키마와 데이터를 검증하며 검증을 위해 업로드하지 않습니다. $ref가 참조하는 URL은 가져오지 않으므로 참조되는 스키마를 해당 칸에 붙여넣으세요.
statements.qualification: Worker에서 검증(Worker 생성 실패 시에만 메인 스레드). 엔진에 fetch가 없다.

statements.statement: 이 브라우저의 localStorage에는 드래프트 메뉴와 ‘format 검사’ 설정만 저장하며 스키마, 참조 스키마, 데이터는 저장하지 않습니다. Ctrl/⌘+L은 현재 입력을 지우고 설정은 유지합니다.
statements.qualification: savePrefs는 두 항목만 저장. 전역 Ctrl+L은 텍스트 입력만 지우고 preference clear는 아무것도 하지 않는다.

statements.statement: 페이지는 Google Analytics와 AdSense를 불러옵니다. 입력·설정 변경 확정, 파일 불러오기, 예시 선택 또는 검증 동작이 완료되면 도구 이름과 결과 종류를 기록합니다.
statements.qualification: disabledPersistenceSlugs에 없어 광고 슬롯과 태그가 활성. trackTool은 run(true)에서만 slug와 action으로 호출된다.

statements.statement: 한글이 NFD(자모 분해) 형태로 들어 있기 때문입니다. maxLength는 유니코드 문자(코드 포인트) 수를 세는데, '홍길동'은 NFC로는 3자, NFD로는 초성·중성·종성으로 나뉘어 9자입니다.
statements.qualification: 2020-12 §6.3.1은 RFC 8259의 문자 수를 말하고, Ajv는 코드 포인트를 센다. NFD 9자는 예제에서 재계산된다.

statements.statement: "format 검사"가 켜져 있으면(기본값) ajv-formats가 구현한 email, uri, date, date-time, time, duration, hostname, ipv4, ipv6, uuid 등 15가지를 검사합니다.
statements.qualification: ASSERTED_FORMATS 15개를 addFormats에 넘기고 체크박스는 checked.

statements.statement: 끄면 format은 주석으로만 쓰이며, 2020-12 규격과 Python jsonschema의 기본 동작과 같습니다.
statements.qualification: 2020-12 §7.2.1은 기본 비활성을 요구. Python도 format_checker 없이는 검사하지 않는다.

statements.statement: 흔한 원인은 드래프트 차이, draft 4~7에서 $ref 옆 키워드(규격상 무시), OpenAPI 3.0의 nullable, 오타처럼 해당 드래프트에 없는 키워드, format 검사 여부, pattern의 \d, 2^53을 넘는 정수입니다.
statements.qualification: prepareSchema가 후기 키워드, $ref 옆 키워드, nullable을 제거하고 알린다.

statements.statement: 데이터의 루트는 배열을 포함해 어떤 JSON 값이든 될 수 있습니다. 여러 레코드는 JSON Lines(한 줄에 JSON 값 하나)나 ---로 구분한 여러 YAML 문서로 붙여넣으세요.
statements.qualification: JSON과 다중 YAML은 설명대로 동작. JSON Lines는 첫 비어 있지 않은 줄이 { 또는 [일 때만 인식되고 스칼라로 시작하는 스트림은 YAML로 실패한다. 페이지는 이 조건을 쓰지 않는다.

statements.statement: macOS의 HFS+ 파일 시스템은 파일 이름을 분해된 형태(NFD)로 저장합니다(Apple Technical Q&A QA1173). 그런 텍스트가 섞여 들어오면 화면에는 '홍길동'으로 보여도 길이 검사에서 걸립니다.
statements.qualification: Apple QA1173이 HFS+의 NFD 저장을 설명한다. 예제의 NFD 문자열은 테스트에서 재계산된다.

statements.statement: maxLength는 유니코드 문자(코드 포인트) 수를 셉니다. NFC '홍길동'은 3자라 통과하고, NFD는 초성·중성·종성이 각각 1자라 9자가 됩니다.
statements.qualification: 2020-12 §6.3.1과 Ajv의 코드 포인트 계산이 일치한다.

statements.statement: 아래 데이터의 name은 JSON 이스케이프로 쓴 NFD '홍길동'입니다.
statements.qualification: 예제 데이터와 출력은 테스트에서 재계산된다.

statements.statement: 2026-10-02에 Bing(한국)에서 "JSON Schema 검증" 결과에 나온 LiteDevTools의 JSON Schema 검증기로 같은 입력을 시험했습니다.
statements.qualification: 날짜가 있는 경쟁 도구 관찰. 이번 실행에서 검색과 요청을 다시 하지 않았다. 역사 기록으로 유지.

statements.statement: 공식 JSON Schema Test Suite의 필수 테스트에서 draft-07은 929개 중 927개, 2020-12는 1,301개 중 1,210개가 기대한 결과이고, 나머지는 "판정할 수 없음"입니다.
statements.qualification: 수치는 동봉 fixture(suite commit 5b0ee1613e45fcc2bddac00e07c19cd49b00d8a8)의 오늘 실행과 일치. 페이지는 suite 버전을 고정하지 않으므로 모든 개정에 대한 주장은 아니다.

statements.statement: multipleOf는 십진수 값으로 판정하므로 19.99는 0.01의 배수, 0.3은 0.1의 배수입니다. 중복된 키는 마지막 값만 남고 안내를 표시합니다.
statements.qualification: YAML의 중복 키는 js-yaml 파싱 오류이며 마지막 값이 남지 않는다. JSON으로 한정했다.

statements.statement: YAML 오류는 경로만 표시하고 행 번호는 표시하지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: YAML 구문 오류는 줄·열을 가진다(테스트가 2행 확인). 행 번호가 없는 것은 YAML 데이터의 검증 오류다. 문구를 한정했다.

statements.statement: 1 MB를 넘는 입력은 "검증" 버튼으로 실행하고, 20 MB를 넘는 파일은 읽지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: AUTO_LIMIT은 세 입력 합계 1,000,000 UTF-16 코드 단위, FILE_LIMIT은 20 * 1024 * 1024바이트(20 MiB). 문구와 fileTooBig을 맞췄다.
